mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.title, q.question_type, q.difficulty, q.knowledge_id, q.options, q.standard_answer, q.score, q.review_status, q.creator_id, q.create_time, q.update_time, k.name AS knowledge_name FROM question q LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, name FROM knowledge_point) k ON q.knowledge_id = k.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
